BIBLIOGRAPHIC RECORD

William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

Selections from ‘Jerusalem’

[Men and States]

(
Jerusalem,
 f. 73, ll. 42–3.)
A
S
 the Pilgrim passes while the Country permanent remains,
So Men pass on, but States remain permanent for ever.
